'''Zach Erwin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam]] on 6 May 2000, according to Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d842">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-06-lvgs-feature-match-4-erwin-v-laffertyd842/ lvgs-feature-match-4-erwin-v-lafferty], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 6 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-06-lvgs-feature-match-4-erwin-v-laffertyd842/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
